title: Check a charitable fundraising licence
summary: Check if an organization is authorized to fundraise for charitable purposes in NSW, or search for your own charitable fundraising licence details online.
intro: If you'd like to check if an organisation is authorised to fundraise for charitable purposes in NSW, or search for your own charitable fundraising licence and details, you can do so online.
what_you_need: location (suburb, postcode and local government area)

how_to_steps.text: Enter the information you have into the search bar.

contact:
Authorised fundraisers in NSW must deal with complaints from members of the public or disputes with employees about fundraising activities. To resolve a dispute with a fundraiser, your first step should be to approach the fundraiser directly.

To submit a complaint or enquiry about charitable fundraising, contact NSW Fair Trading.
